rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something old-fashioned or no longer up to date.

example.english: The interface of this software is too antiquated; nobody wants to use it anymore.
example.traditional: 呢套軟件個介面太過時，依家冇人想用。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 jyun5 gin2 go3 gaai3 min6 taai3 gwo3 si4 ji1 gaa1 mou5 jan4 soeng2 jung6

rows.note: Use this especially for a person's appearance, taste, or style when it looks unfashionably old-fashioned.

example.english: If you dress like that to go for dim sum, your look is really antiquated.
example.traditional: 你着成咁去飲茶，個造型真係好老土。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoek6 sing4 gam3 heoi3 jam2 caa4 go3 zou6 jing4 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 tou2

rows.note: Use this for a person, idea, method, or system that has fallen behind the times.

example.english: This management method is antiquated and should be changed.
example.traditional: 呢套管理方法已經落伍，應該改吓。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 gun2 lei5 fong1 faat3 ji5 ging1 lok6 ng5 jing1 goi1 goi2 haa5
